text: {"lessons":["My recent buys and sells did not establish a reliable way to time prices; with changes unpredictable, I should base trades on my target allocation rather than recent moves.","Selling some winners and later buying again shows how easily frequent timing decisions can work against a consistent plan; I should trade only when my portfolio needs rebalancing.","I should consider the whole account, including cash and concentration across stocks, and avoid letting average cost or loss aversion dictate whether I hold, buy, or sell."]}
